ability.name: Furious Temper
ability.effect:
For the rest of the turn:
• Add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons.
• Subtract 1 from save rolls for this unit.

ability.name: Rabble Rouser
ability.effect: Add 1 to charge rolls for friendly **^^Sons of Behemat^^** units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

ability.name: Monstrously Tough
ability.effect: This unit has a Health characteristic of 40 instead of 35.

ability.name: Terrifying Hulk
ability.effect: If this unit is not in combat, roll a dice. On a 3+, you can change one of the dice in that charge roll to a 1.

ability.name: Grabby
ability.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s combat attacks that target an enemy unit contesting an objective you do not control.

ability.name: Mega-Grump
ability.effect: This unit has Ward (5+) while it has 25 or more damage points.
